title: unified-rollouts: optimize canary/A-B/shadow autorollback decision latency and observability
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Improve autorollback decision latency and observability for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow). This PR reduces the time between metric ingress and rollback decision, extends metric provenance traces, and adds stability guards and e2e tests for common failure modes. Motivation: Customers observed long tail decision delays during high-throughput canary windows and insufficient tracing when rollbacks triggered. That led to slow mitigation and noisy oncall escalations. This change targets three pain points: 1) decision latency under load, 2) sparse observability for metric correlation, and 3) brittle test coverage for rollback workflows. Changes include: - prioritized metric ingestion path and batching improvements in the autorollback engine (lower median decision latency) - early escape for stale probes and quorum-based quarantine to avoid oscillating rollouts - enhanced trace context propagation through routing/rollout-engine -> runtime -> metrics pipeline - new per-rollout decision logs and a lightweight sampling mode for token-level traces in high-volume rollouts - e2e stability tests that simulate partial observer failures, metric skew, and delayed kv-cache refresh - minor API addition: rollout.status.reason (string) to surface automated rollback rationale Checklists: - [x] unit tests for rollback engine changes - [x] integration tests for metric ingestion backpressure - [x] e2e tests for canary and shadow rollback scenarios - [x] observability dashboards updated - [x] documentation snippet for rollout.status.reason Compatibility/Notes: rollout.status.reason is additive and backward compatible; controllers and console gracefully ignore unknown fields. Performance: internal benchmark harness shows ~35% reduction in P95 decision latency under a simulated 1k rps canary workload. Rollout: will be released to staging, monitored for 48h, then rolled to prod. Related: ENG-1874 (autorollback perf), ENG-2020 (observability for rollouts).

- Add ingestion capacity metric and dashboard panels
